## Instructions

1. Melt the butter, sugar and cocoa over hot water. Add the egg and stir till thick. Take off the heat, add crumbs, coconut and nuts. Press into an 8 x 8 pan.
2. Cream the butter, pudding powder and milk. Beat in the icing sugar. Spread over the base and chill.
3. Melt the chocolate with the butter, spread on top. Chill before cutting.
